dialogues.speaker: Reza
dialogues.text: Hello, I'm the Port Master of Port Ormos, in charge of tax levies, customs, etc.

dialogues.speaker: Reza
dialogues.text: Come see me or my chief secretary for any questions regarding trade.

dialogues.speaker: Reza
dialogues.text: And make sure to report any violations. Everyone will thank you for it... except the offenders.
